x: Shown here at the McDonald's YA League at Peterborough matching strides out of the blocks with Blackheath's Mark Findlay, Marlon Dickson had a great 1994 season.

Unfortunately, in spite of repeated attempts, we have been unable to obtain a set of results from the organisers but we can point out a couple of the outstanding events as far as we were concerned. Marlon Dickson was up against 10.88 man Mark Findlay and not surprisingly had his work cut out in the individual 100m.
The headwind was recorded at 1.5m/s and second place Mark Findlay was 0.32 sec behind which gave the true measure of Chris' extraordinary breakthrough.
